name: How do I prepare my bathroom for a new shower installation?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my bathroom for a new shower installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your bathroom for a new shower installation, clear out any personal items, towels, and decorations from the work area to prevent damage and allow our team unobstructed access. If you have chosen a custom tile shower, you may need to finalize your tile selection in advance. Ensuring a clear path to the bathroom and easy access to your main water shut-off valve can help streamline the installation process. Our team will guide you on specific preparation steps during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear personal items from the work area and ensure a clear path to the bathroom. Finalizing material selections and knowing your main water shut-off valve location can help prepare.
